annotations.title: Seller payment record: who has paid an x402 seller in USDC

description: See whether other buyers pay an x402 seller before you do: every USDC transfer into its payout wallet over the last 1-7 days from public logs on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, with payments, distinct and repeat payers, total and median amount, first and last payment and top payers. Give the payout wallet or the paid endpoint's URL. Counts all USDC received, x402 or not. Use before the first payment to an unfamiliar seller. Example: address=0x6293ded2684F1A76E26bEcef87c137D691Fbf800. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: The seller's payout wallet (0x). Or send url instead

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

url.description: Or: the paid x402 endpoint; its quote's payout wallet is read
